ev.q: During 2007–2010, on average, 4.7% of the daily calories consumed by U.S. adults aged ≥20 years came from alcoholic beverages.
The percentage of daily calories from alcohol ranged from 6.5% for men aged 20–39 years to 2.1% for women aged ≥60 years.
